en.title: Forest
en.description: Deep within the ancient Black Forest, where towering pines filter golden morning light and birds compose their daily symphony among the misty canopy.

zh.title: 森林
zh.description: 在古老的黑森林深处，高耸的松树过滤着金色的晨光，鸟儿在朦胧的林冠间谱写每日的交响曲。

en.title: Ocean
en.description: Along the rugged coastline of Big Sur, where Pacific waves crash against ancient cliffs and the horizon melts into shades of amber and violet.

zh.title: 大海
zh.description: 沿着大苏尔崎岖的海岸线，太平洋的浪花拍打着古老的悬崖，地平线融入琥珀色和紫色的光芒中。

en.title: Lake
en.description: At the mirror-still waters of Lake Bled, where morning mist rises gently and the surrounding Alps reflect perfectly in the crystal-clear surface.

zh.title: 湖泊
zh.description: 在如镜的布莱德湖畔，晨雾轻柔升起，周围的阿尔卑斯山完美地倒映在清澈的水面上。

en.title: Spring
en.description: Among the cascading waterfalls of Plitvice, where crystal springs emerge from mossy rocks and create an endless melody as they dance over limestone terraces.

zh.title: 泉水
zh.location: 克罗地亚普利特维采湖群
zh.description: 在普利特维采层叠的瀑布间，清澈的泉水从苔藓覆盖的岩石中涌出，在石灰岩阶地上舞动出无尽的旋律。
